name: 陳靜儀
objective:
The "Data-informed Design Thinking" course aims to combine data analysis and design thinking to improve students' problem-solving abilities in modern design environments through practical projects. This course will guide students in how to extract key insights from data, combining user needs, creative thinking and solution prototype development in design thinking. Students will learn how to effectively apply data to support design decisions and innovation. The course uses Project-Based Learning as the teaching model. Students will explore how to combine data with design thinking in actual design projects, and ultimately deliver a complete data-driven design solution and data visualization. The course will use selected communities in Taipei City as the research site. Through open data, it will explore the challenges faced by urban communities and propose innovative and practical solutions. Students will learn how to use data-driven design methods to develop futuristic and feasible design concepts, and communicate with experts and industry representatives.

「數據啟發設計思考（Data-informed Design Thinking）」課程旨在結合數據分析與設計思考，通過實踐項目提升學生在現代設計環境中的問題解決能力。本課程將引導學生掌握如何從數據中提取關鍵洞察，並結合設計思考中的使用者需求、創意思考與解決方案原型的開發。學生將學習如何有效地應用數據，來支持設計決策與創新。課程以 Project-Based Learning 為教學模式，學生將在實際設計項目中探索如何將數據與設計思考相結合，最終交付一個完整的數據驅動設計解決方案與數據視覺化。課程將以臺北市選定的社區為研究場域，透過開放數據，探索都市社區面臨的挑戰，並提出創新且實際的解決方案。學生將學習如何運用數據啟發的設計方法，發展出具未來性與可行性的設計概念，並與專家及業界代表交流。
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 01
Course Introduction; Introduction to Data-Informed Design Thinking and Types of Data Visualization; Team Formation
課程介紹；數據啟發設計思考與資料視覺化類型介紹；分組

Week 02
Types of Data Visualization
資料視覺化類型

Week 03
Part I: Design Concept Development and Familiarization with Data Visualization Tools and Platforms  Part II: Field Trip—Visit to the City Science Lab at Taipei Tech
第一部分：設計概念發展與資料視覺化工具及平台操作  
第二部分：校外教學 — 參觀臺北科技大學城市科學實驗室

Week 04
Open Data and Big Data
開放資料與大數據

Week 05
Datasets, Data Cleaning, and Feature Engineering
資料集、資料清理與特徵工程

Week 06
Data Visualization Practice and Team Project Development
資料視覺化實作與小組專題發展

Week 07
Team Project Presentation I
第一次小組專題簡報

Week 08
Urban Dynamic Data Visualization I
都市動態資料視覺化（一）

Week 09
Urban Dynamic Data Visualization II
都市動態資料視覺化（二）

Weeks 10–13
Design Studio—Team Project Development
設計工作坊 — 小組專題實作

Week 14
Progress Review Presentation II
第二次專題進度報告

Week 15
Team Discussion, Project Refinement, and Iteration
小組討論、專題調整與迭代

Week 16
Final Project Presentation
期末專題成果發表

Weeks 17–18
Promotional Video and Short-Form Video Production: Produce a 3–5-minute project promotional video and a 30-second short-form video, and upload both videos to the designated online platform.
成果宣傳影片與短影音製作：製作一支 3 至 5 分鐘的專題成果宣傳影片及一支 30 秒短影音，並將兩支影片上傳至指定的線上平台。

延伸教學與資源: ● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
